name: Cosmo
description: A man in his late twenties, a retro nineteen-sixties cosmonaut who sings sparkling Italo space-disco, sunny, earnest and wholehearted.
build: A sturdy, average adult man's build of human proportions, made boxy by the suit: broad squared shoulders, a straight thick torso and straight legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Fair pink-toned skin, round bright blue eyes under straight sandy brows, round cheeks, a snub nose, a square dimpled chin and a wide mouth.
hair: Short sandy-blond hair in a neat side-parted crew cut, flat and tidy.
outfit: A boxy one-piece space suit in bright tangerine-orange with thick ribbed accordion rings at the elbows and knees; a wide round white collar ring at the neck for a helmet; a big square white chest control box with three large round red, yellow and blue buttons; wide white cuff rings at the wrists, both hands in white rubber gloves fitted to every finger; a wide white belt; chunky white moon boots. His round bubble helmet, a solid white shell with an opaque faintly tinted pale-blue glass dome, hangs clipped by a short strap at the character-left hip. His head is bare.
performance_style: Sunny and upright: feet hip-width apart, weight even on both boots. Both arms hang relaxed at his sides, the character-right and character-left gloved hands open and empty beside the thighs, every finger visible. Head level, a bright closed-mouth smile.
location: A retro sixties space-station disco, seen from the front of a lit-up dance floor of big square orange, yellow and white tiles running to the bottom of the frame, a round porthole window onto Earth and stars, and a large mirror ball overhead.
recognition_cues: a boxy bright tangerine-orange space suit with ribbed rings at elbows and knees
a round white helmet with a pale-blue glass dome clipped at the hip
a square white chest box with big red, yellow and blue buttons
palette: collar ring, chest box, gloves, belt, boots and helmet shell white #F2F0EA / #BEBAB0 / #FFFFFF
avoid: the helmet worn on the head
the helmet held under the arm

sing.intent: Space-disco vocal loop: bring the mic in the gloved character-right hand up to the mouth, point the gloved character-left index finger up and across on the beat in a disco point, then lower the mic and return to the sunny stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a loud room sound: the shoulders lift, the torso draws back slightly and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: walk in with bouncy slow-motion moon steps, turn square to the front, then land in the sunny stance with both gloved hands open at his sides.
